senses.gloss: torai (SITI), Tamil; a standard linear measure of four fingers' breadth.

toraṇa (CII 4; LL; CITD), an arch; a gateway; an arched doorway; a portal; a temporary ornamental arch; also a garland in Telugu-Kannaḍa.
 Cf. toraṇa-kkāṇikkai (SITI), tax on gates or presents for decorating the village with arches.
toraṇa-kkāṇikkai (SITI), Tamil; presents for decorating the village with arches, etc.; or tax on gates.
